name: Ashley
source:
Ashley, Daughter of Mia, spends most of her time working in her mothers cafe or working out. Being the daughter of a woman such as Mia, and not actively having a father figure in her life, it is fair to assume that some of her behavior may not fall in line with what most girls her age would consider normal.
